title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity fixes, bump v1.145.0
author: Aisha Raman
ci_checks: ci/e2e-streaming: flaky on first run -> rerun -> pass
release_notes: Unify SDK auth, retries, and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go; parity fixes for method names and configuration; bump SDK versions to v1.145.0. Migration notes included for a small Go config rename.
description: Motivation: We have drifted across SDKs in how auth headers, retry backoff, and streaming callbacks are surfaced. This causes customer confusion, duplicated docs, and makes cross-language examples brittle. This PR unifies ergonomics and parity across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, fixes several parity bugs, and bumps packaged SDK versions to v1.145.0. Summary of changes: 1) Auth: standardize environment variable names (REDWOOD_API_KEY), unify header injection logic, and centralize token refresh logic in each SDK. 2) Retries: introduce a shared retry config shape (max_attempts, base_backoff_ms, jitter, retryable_statuses) across languages; default policy aligned with server SLOs; added telemetry for retry counts. 3) Streaming: harmonize streaming API surface - callback-based and async iterator parity between TS/Python and idiomatic channel for Go; improved backpressure semantics and cancelation handling; clear examples added. 4) Parity fixes: minor method renames (generate -> create_text_completion alias added), correct typed responses in TS, ensure Go response types match console schema. 5) Version bumps: python: v1.145.0, typescript: v1.145.0, go: v1.145.0. Checklist: - [x] Unify auth behavior and tests - [x] Implement shared retry config and tests - [x] Streaming API parity + e2e tests - [x] Docs updates and quickstarts for all 3 SDKs - [x] Release/version bumps and packaging - [x] Migration notes for Go rename (documented) Testing & CI: unit tests updated across all SDKs; e2e streaming tests run in CI (flaky first run, reran and passed). Performance: no measurable regression in library throughput; retries telemetry added to monitor production impact. Migration notes: small Go SDK config rename (ClientOptions.RetryConfig -> ClientOptions.Retries) to match naming used in Python/TS; a one-line change for downstream code documented in migration_notes.md and release notes. Rollback plan: revert release tag and revert merge commit; infra-safe since no server-side changes. Related: Linear ENG-11234 (SDK parity initiative), ENG-11567 (streaming stability).
commits: feat(py): centralize auth header injection and token refresh handling
feat(ts): introduce shared RetryConfig type and default policy
feat(go): add streaming iterator abstraction and match response types
fix(ts): ensure typed responses follow console schema
chore: bump sdk versions to v1.145.0 and update changelogs
test: add e2e streaming tests and retry telemetry tests
docs: update quickstarts and migration notes
review_comments: Diego Morales: Nice consolidation - can you add a short note explaining why base_backoff_ms is in milliseconds vs seconds (we follow ms internally for better granularity)?
Aisha Raman: Answered: ms chosen to keep parity with existing infra metrics and to avoid float precision differences in some languages, added note in retries.ts and retries.py docs.
Priya Desai: Request change: TS streaming API returns ReadableStream in one place and async iterator in another; could we expose both but prefer iterator?
Aisha Raman: Updated TS to expose async iterator as primary and provide a small adapter to ReadableStream for web customers, added tests.
Liam O'Connor: Approved after CI green and docs updated - left minor nit about error message wording in Go client.
Aisha Raman: Addressed nit, adjusted error text and added unit test for error formatting.
CI Bot: e2e streaming flaky on first run; rerun triggered by Diego Morales; all checks passed on rerun.
migration_notes: Go: ClientOptions.RetryConfig renamed to ClientOptions.Retries; update import path and field name in client construction (example provided in docs/sdk-migration-notes.md).
Python: environment variable REDWOOD_API_KEY is preferred but legacy names still supported with deprecation warning.
TypeScript: streaming adapter provided for web ReadableStream callers; prefer async iterator in new examples.
notes: This PR was coordinated with release engineering to ensure simultaneous packaging for all three SDKs. Tagging release v1.145.0 on merge. We will monitor retry telemetry and streaming error rates for one week post-release.
changelog_entry: SDK: unify auth, retries, and streaming APIs across Python/TS/Go; parity fixes and version bump to v1.145.0. See migration notes for small Go field rename.
